Name: Pearl Medium Classic Onyx - The Perfect Urn Vault
Natural: The Perfect Urn Vault is as versatile as it is beautiful. Not only is this a cremation urn, but also a ground burial vault. These urns serve as a focal point during a memorial service and are appropriate for in-home display, as vessels for burial, or as a lasting tribute after a loved ones cremains have been scattered. The Perfect Urn Vault is easily personalized and is designed to fit within variously sized niches and columbariums. The Pearl Medium Classic Onyx cremation urn is hand-crafted from a precise blend of stone, resin and color pigments which emulate natural elements. Materials are carefully selected for their inherent strength, intrinsic beauty and enduring luster. Onyx is a translucent, semi-precious gemstone of quartz variety with extremely fine crystal formation. Ancient Egyptians, Greeks and Romans acknowledged Onyx for its mystical properties and adorned places of worship with it. Today, Onyx is recognized for providing comfort, promoting balance and relieving stress. Our cultured onyx combines limestone (mined in Georgia), natural color pigments (formulated in Colorado) and synthetic polyester resin (blended in Kentucky). The material is cold cast into specially designed molds, and then hand polished to a high luster shine. The Pearl Medium Classic Onyx cremation urn opens from the bottom with a threaded sealing disc and air-tight gasket. The U.S Transportation Security Administration (TSA) has tested and approved "The Perfect Urn Vault" as x-rayable and permissible carry-on items, consistent with the new Department of Homeland Security screening procedures and regulations.
